items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: One night we went out. We weren't playing, another band was playing, so he was sitting down, and a lady came up, and she asked him to dance.

ctx.x: One leg shodd another. One leg shodd another.

One leg shodd another. One leg shodd another. One leg shodd another. Yeah, one leg shodd another. Yeah, one leg shodd another. Was he any good? Was he any good? Oh yeah, he's a nice musician. Good trombone player. One night we went out. We weren't playing, another band was playing, so he was sitting down, and a lady came up, and she asked him to dance. So he kept telling me he didn't want to dance, but she kept insisting. So when he got up to dance, she asked him, what was he doing, shouting? One leg shodd…
What about, which year was it, right before the war you stayed?
